reapack.name: Gumbo starter sounds
reapack.desc: Gumbo starter sounds - 12 free instruments for Gumbo (piano, strings, brass, winds, harp, organ, marimba, timpani) from VSCO 2 Community Edition

metadata.description: Twelve instruments for Gumbo at full quality: upright piano, violin and cello sections, plucked strings, French horn, trumpet, flute, clarinet, harp, organ, marimba and timpani. From VSCO 2 Community Edition by Versilian Studios, public domain (CC0 1.0).

version.author: Quaz (EON Studios)
version.changelog: Moved to its own repository, Gumbo-Sounds; the browser icons now come with Gumbo itself.
